freshness: (() => { const qa = window.__marketQA; if (!qa) return { checked: 0, stale: 0, example: null }; const now = performance.now(); const vw = window.innerWidth, vh = window.innerHeight; let checked = 0, stale = 0, example = null; for (const tr of document.querySelectorAll('tr[data-symbol]')) { const rb = tr.getBoundingClientRect(); if (rb.height === 0 || rb.bottom <= 0 || rb.top >= vh) continue; const row = parseInt(tr.getAttribute('data-symbol').slice(3), 10); for (const td of tr.querySelectorAll('td[data-field]')) { const b = td.getBoundingClientRect(); if (b.right <= 0 || b.left >= vw || b.bottom <= 0 || b.top >= vh) continue; const field = td.getAttribute('data-field'); const rec = qa.recent(row, field); const shown = td.textContent; checked++; if (shown === rec.value.toFixed(2)) continue; if (now - rec.changedAt <= 500 && shown === rec.previous.toFixed(2)) continue; stale++; if (!example) example = { id: tr.getAttribute('data-symbol'), field, shown, truth: rec.value.toFixed(2) }; } } return { checked, stale, example }; })()

interactions.name: sort last descending
interactions.until: (() => { const th = document.querySelector('th[data-field=last]'); if (th.getAttribute('aria-sort') !== 'descending') return false; const rows = [...document.querySelectorAll('tr[data-symbol]')].filter(tr => { const b = tr.getBoundingClientRect(); return b.height > 0 && b.bottom > 0 && b.top < window.innerHeight; }); if (rows.length < 2) return false; const v = tr => parseFloat(tr.querySelector('td[data-field=last]').textContent); return v(rows[0]) >= v(rows[1]); })()

interactions.name: sort last ascending
interactions.until: (() => { const th = document.querySelector('th[data-field=last]'); if (th.getAttribute('aria-sort') !== 'ascending') return false; const rows = [...document.querySelectorAll('tr[data-symbol]')].filter(tr => { const b = tr.getBoundingClientRect(); return b.height > 0 && b.bottom > 0 && b.top < window.innerHeight; }); if (rows.length < 2) return false; const v = tr => parseFloat(tr.querySelector('td[data-field=last]').textContent); return v(rows[0]) <= v(rows[1]); })()

interactions.name: sort volume descending
interactions.until: (() => { const th = document.querySelector('th[data-field=volume]'); if (th.getAttribute('aria-sort') !== 'descending') return false; const rows = [...document.querySelectorAll('tr[data-symbol]')].filter(tr => { const b = tr.getBoundingClientRect(); return b.height > 0 && b.bottom > 0 && b.top < window.innerHeight; }); if (rows.length < 2) return false; const v = tr => parseFloat(tr.querySelector('td[data-field=volume]').textContent); return v(rows[0]) >= v(rows[1]); })()

interactions.name: filter symbols
interactions.until: (() => { if ((document.querySelector('.count')?.textContent || '') !== '100 instruments') return false; const rows = [...document.querySelectorAll('tr[data-symbol]')]; if (rows.length === 0) return false; return rows.every(tr => tr.getAttribute('data-symbol').toLowerCase().includes('sym01')); })()
